Embroidery & Badges

Overview

From single crests to bulk runs of thousands, our embroidery line covers badges, patches, and emblem work for uniforms, sports teams, institutions, and branded merchandise. Thread colours are matched to your reference, and every design is sampled before it goes to bulk.

Customization options

  • Thread matching: Colours matched to your Pantone or physical reference.
  • Backing options: Iron-on, sew-on, or Velcro backing.
  • Technique: Hand embroidery for fine detail, machine embroidery for volume.
  • Sizing: Made to your exact dimensions.

How to order

Send your design, logo, or a reference sample along with quantity and sizing. We'll confirm specification and get a sample underway before anything moves to bulk.
